purpose: Phase-7C Part 2 immune renderer registry (read-only visualization layer). Defines component display titles, colour palettes (biological interpretation only - a DISTINCT unavailable palette; confidence has its OWN encoding, never reusing biological-magnitude colour), category->palette mapping, accessibility icons/labels, value bands, and the render severity vocabulary + mapping from runtime issue severities. The renderer NEVER creates biology / warnings / transitions - it only presents immutable published outputs. All render constants are registry-driven.

confidence_encoding.note: Confidence uses a SEPARATE visual channel (opacity band) so it is never confused with biological magnitude (colour).

accessibility.note: Never rely on colour alone; every component also carries icon + label + text value + state description.

render_severity.note: Render severity is derived deterministically from the immutable runtime-issue severity; the renderer never invents severities.

invariants.read_only: The renderer consumes immutable published objects and mutates nothing.
invariants.no_biology: The renderer never estimates, smooths, or interpolates biological values (replay may interpolate VISUAL position only).
invariants.unavailable_visible: Unavailable values are shown with the distinct unavailable palette + text, never as zero.
